queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Pale Moon %' AND publisher = 'Moonchild Productions';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Pale Moon %' AND publisher = 'Moonchild Productions' AND version_compare(version, '35.0.3') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'palemoon.exe');
